model_output.cross_horizon_summary: Broad crypto has a downside lean over 12h, a lower-confidence downside lean over 72h, and no defensible directional edge over 168h. Deteriorating participation and observed selling pressure outweigh modest BTC/ETH stabilization near term. BTC remains relatively resilient, but this has not transmitted into broad altcoin strength. Transmission labels describe current evidence, not a guaranteed future trajectory. These are non-binding descriptive forecasts with no portfolio execution authority.

The small-alt proxy covers only the Top-100 tail; microcap transmission is unavailable.

Catalyst context is degraded. Macro levels lack a supplied change sequence, and stablecoin deployment is not established.
